import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Credit Card Fraud Detection Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.00)

# 1. Fraud Distribution by Transaction Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
fraud_by_type = pd.crosstab(df['transaction_type'], df['is_fraud'], normalize='index') * 100
fraud_by_type.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], width=0.7)
ax1.set_title('Fraud Rate by Transaction Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=10)
ax1.legend(['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], title='Transaction Status')
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction Amount Distribution (Fraud vs Non-Fraud)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
fraud_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 1]['amount']
legit_amounts = df[df['is_fraud'] == 0]['amount']
ax2.hist([legit_amounts, fraud_amounts], bins=30, label=['Legitimate', 'Fraud'], 
         color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Transaction Amount Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Fraud Activity by Hour of Day
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
hourly_fraud = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'] = (hourly_fraud['sum'] / hourly_fraud['count']) * 100
ax3.plot(hourly_fraud.index, hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], marker='o', 
         linewidth=2, markersize=6, color='#e74c3c')
ax3.fill_between(hourly_fraud.index, hourly_fraud['fraud_rate'], alpha=0.3, color='#e74c3c')
ax3.set_title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Fraud Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Box plot of Amount by Fraud Status and Transaction Type
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['fraud_status'] = df['is_fraud'].map({0: 'Legitimate', 1: 'Fraud'})
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='fraud_status', 
            ax=ax4, palette={'Legitimate': '#2ecc71', 'Fraud': '#e74c3c'})
ax4.set_title('Amount Distribution by Type and Fraud Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.legend(title='Status', loc='upper right')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
